// Package cacheApp implements the main Cache Service application that consumes
// analysed data from Kafka and stores it in Redis.
package cacheApp

import (
	
	
	analyseDataProvider 
	
	
	
)

// Consumer defines the interface for Kafka message consumption lifecycle.
type Consumer interface {
	StartWorkerPull(ctx context.Context) error
	Consume(ctx context.Context) error
	Close()
}

// App represents the Cache Service application with Kafka consumer lifecycle.
type App struct {
	log      *slog.Logger
	consumer Consumer

	cancel context.CancelFunc
}

// New creates a new App instance, initializing Redis and Kafka consumer.
func ( *slog.Logger,  *config.Config) *App {

	 := redis.NewRedisController(
		.RedisConfig.Host,
		.RedisConfig.Password,
		.RedisConfig.DB,
		.RedisConfig.Port,
		.TokenTTL,
	)

	 := analyseDataProvider.NewRedisService(, , .TokenTTL)

	 := kafka.NewConsumer(
		,
		[]string{.KafkaConfig.Host},
		.KafkaConfig.Topic,
		.KafkaConfig.ConsumerGroup,
		int32(.KafkaConfig.MaxPulls),
		,
	)
	.Info("Consumer created")
	return &App{
		log:      ,
		consumer: ,
	}
}

// MustRun starts the cache service and panics on error.
func ( *App) () {
	,  := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	.cancel = 
	if  := .Run();  != nil {
		panic()
	}
}

// Run starts the Kafka consumer and worker pull in background goroutines.
func ( *App) ( context.Context) error {
	const  = "grpcApp"

	.log.With(slog.String("op", ))

	go .consumer.StartWorkerPull()
	go .consumer.Consume()
	return nil

}

// Stop cancels the context, gracefully shutting down the consumer.
func ( *App) () {
	const  = "grpcApp"

	.log.With(slog.String("op", ))

	if .cancel != nil {
		.cancel()
	}

}
